questions.q: Which arm of government is primarily responsible for the execution and enforcement of laws?
questions.exp: The Executive branch, headed by the president/cabinet, implements and administers laws.

questions.q: What is the primary purpose of the principle of 'Separation of Powers' in a democratic state?

options.t: To prevent tyranny and abuse of power by dividing governmental functions
To unify all state leadership into one office

questions.exp: Separation of powers ensures checks and balances across the executive, legislative, and judicial branches.

questions.q: Which of the following is considered a fundamental human right enshrined in modern constitutions?

options.t: Exemption from paying all municipal taxes
Guaranteed employment in the civil service

questions.exp: Freedom of speech is a universally recognized fundamental civil liberty.

questions.q: What does Sustainable Development primarily aim to achieve?

options.t: Meeting current societal needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet theirs
Maximized industrial output regardless of carbon emissions
Strict preservation of all natural resources with zero human utilization
Rapid urbanization centered around heavy manufacturing

questions.exp: Sustainable development balances economic growth, social inclusion, and environmental protection.

questions.q: Which environmental strategy directly reduces urban vehicle emissions and particulate pollution?

options.t: Promoting automated vehicle emissions testing and public transit systems

questions.exp: Emissions testing units and public transport reduce carbon footprints and improve air quality.
